highlights.title: Agents move off an account that is running out
highlights.line: With two or more Claude subscriptions, Kosmos moves idle agents off one near its weekly limit to one with room. Settings can turn it off.

highlights.title: A starred agent stands out
highlights.line: A starred agent's star is solid bright gold now, with a small burst of sparks when you star it.

highlights.title: A crashed session no longer blocks an agent
highlights.line: An agent shown as blocked by its provider after a session crashed now clears when the next session first finishes a reply.

highlights.title: On a phone, the Claude code box comes into view
highlights.line: On a phone, a Kosmos Cloud machine's first Claude sign-in scrolls the box for the Claude code into view, with a fade while more is below.

highlights.title: A long conversation keeps your place
highlights.line: Reading back through a long conversation, a moment's failed read no longer moves you; one line at the end says so.
